updates.en: Added 17 source-checked preprints from 19–25 November, covering self-editing, reusable retrieval recipes, robot repair, closed-form adaptation, security and informative negative results. See the [dated review](docs/literature-update-2026-11-26.md). Merged community PRs [#12](https://github.com/Boom5426/Awesome-Weight-Space-Programming/pull/12) (metric correction) and [#13](https://github.com/Boom5426/Awesome-Weight-Space-Programming/pull/13) (related list).
updates.zh: 补充 11 月 19—25 日的 17 篇已核对原文预印本，覆盖自编辑、检索规则复用、机器人修复、闭式适应、安全及有信息量的负面结果，详见[本轮整理](docs/literature-update-2026-11-26.md)。合并社区 PR [#12](https://github.com/Boom5426/Awesome-Weight-Space-Programming/pull/12)（统计口径修正）和 [#13](https://github.com/Boom5426/Awesome-Weight-Space-Programming/pull/13)（相关资源列表）。

updates.en: Added [Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21885) to Direct WSP and the evidence matrix: a 27B model reports gradient-free self-editing (+6.6 percentage points on held-out problems) and eight accepted improvement sessions, with scope and retention caveats.
updates.zh: 新增[Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21885) 至直接 WSP 与证据矩阵：27B 模型通过免梯度自我编辑，在未见测试题上报告提升 6.6 个百分点，并经历 8 轮被接受的修改；同时标明能力保持与泛化证据边界。

updates.en: Curated a selective, evidence-driven [Start Here](#start-here): prominently featured [HypoLoop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23718) for feedback-driven scientific editing, removed unsupported conjectural and preliminary diffusion entries, and kept weak or negative experimental results accessible without treating them as recommended starting points. Earlier this day, updated [WeightCode](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.25476) and added new WSP studies.
updates.zh: 按实证质量精简[入门推荐](#start-here)：重点推荐科学反馈驱动的 [HypoLoop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23718)，剔除缺乏已完成实验的扩散猜想和早期方案条目，保留有信息量的负面结果但不作为首选阅读。同日已修正 [WeightCode](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.25476) 链接并扩充 WSP 文献。

updates.en: Source-checked two new WSP studies: an independent [replication and extension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21449) of the original read/write claims, and [rule-to-network compilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16981) on unseen games with program and learning baselines.
updates.zh: 核对并新增两篇 WSP 研究：对原始读写结论的[独立复现与扩展](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21449)，以及在未公开游戏上将规则编译为网络、并与程序和学习基线对照的[研究](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16981)。

updates.en: Source-checked five more WSP papers, updated Autoresearch to the iWSP preprint, and added EditLens plus an [evaluation research guide](docs/wsp-research-opportunities.md).
updates.zh: 核对五篇 WSP 论文的证据，将 Autoresearch 更新为 iWSP 预印本，补充 EditLens 和[评估研究指南](docs/wsp-research-opportunities.md)。

updates.en: Improved the interactive map and catalog with Chinese search, clearer navigation, mobile track browsing and paginated results.
updates.zh: 优化交互式研究图谱与检索页面：支持中文检索、准确的分支导航、移动端目录和分页浏览。

updates.en: Added a structured bilingual bibliography with validation and evidence fields, plus historical foundations and robot-policy weight programming.
updates.zh: 引入结构化双语文献库、自动校验与证据字段，并补充早期权重编程基础和机器人策略编辑研究。

updates.en: Expanded **Weight-Centric Research** to **67 papers** across six tracks, with dedicated surveys and evaluation resources.
updates.zh: **权重相关研究**扩充至 **67 篇**，覆盖六条研究线，并补充综述和评估资源。

updates.en: Launched a separate bilingual **Weight-Centric Research** companion series.
updates.zh: 上线独立的中英文 **Weight-Centric Research** 专题系列。
